display_long_description:
* This app is designed for fans of specific works and characters. It may not be enjoyable for everyone like a general game. Please check the current booth list before purchasing. More content is planned.

CROSSIA is a Web & XR entertainment platform for fans who want to experience characters and their worlds in a closer, more special way.

Current booths:
• Aoyagi Kaiya (3D): Ended
• Afro Samurai (2D): Available
• Sayo / SAYO (3D): Available
• Gomano Rio (2D): Available
• Mashiro Io (2D): Available
• Yamabuki Shion (2D): Available
• EiL (2D): Available
• KIRA (2D): Available

Main experiences:
1. VR photo sessions in themed virtual spaces
2. Ticket-based special fan experiences
3. Ongoing events and new character content

This app is not fan-made or derivative. It is provided through official collaborations, so available experiences are limited to currently collaborating anime works, VTubers, and creators.

Depending on the work or character, the VR photo booth may use either a 2D panel or a 3D model. 2D panel booths are also designed for clear and attractive VR photos.

To join experiences, you need tickets inside VR. Your first app purchase includes 500 coins, usable for tickets worth 500 coins. Additional coins can be purchased in VR as needed.

CROSSIA is currently available as a beta version. Experiences, characters, and features may be added or updated over time.
